title: Weekly portfolio snapshot carries settled history
query: It is Monday morning. One experiment was archived before Sunday evening, another settled just after Sunday evening, and last week's report contains an untested rollout idea. Produce the self-improvement review and decide what history informs this wave.
reference_points: Binds an explicit portfolio cutoff and treats it as a snapshot rather than an experiment deadline
Reads the active packet, recent archived packet, previous report cursor, Reward rows, program, progress, and cited evidence before generating candidates
Includes the result archived before cutoff in the current outcome ledger and defers the later settlement to the next report
Treats the prior report as carryover/dedupe context while canonical ticket evidence wins
Writes the dated report before selecting any new packet and performs no check-in

title: A due but unscored experiment remains visible
query: A delayed policy experiment's check-in date passed yesterday, but its Reward row still has no actual result or score. A proposed experiment would touch the same policy surface. What should the weekly review report and admit?
reference_points: Classifies the existing experiment as due_but_unscored rather than accepting, killing, or checking it in
Records the missing result/evidence in the due-but-unscored and source-gap views
Counts the experiment as active WIP and blocks the conflicting same-surface proposal
Does not block unrelated candidates solely because this row is due
Leaves scoring and next-check-in mutation to Pulse and the original ticket worker

title: Delayed monitoring does not serialize immediate proof
query: The portfolio has one legitimate long-running market pilot in monitoring state. Total WIP is 1. Two cheap toy eval candidates touch different skills and return signals immediately. Review capacity and select the next wave.
reference_points: Counts the monitoring pilot toward total WIP and the delayed-live cap
Computes two available total slots from WIP limit 3 and wave size 2
Rejects another live delayed pilot while the delayed-live cap is occupied
May select both non-interfering immediate toy evals because they touch unoccupied surfaces
Creates at most two complete Goal Packets and executes none

title: Accepted toy evidence is transferred cautiously
query: A completed local replay shows that one planner instruction improves a scored behavior on its source skill. The previous report proposed copying it broadly. What should this week's portfolio review do?
reference_points: Records the accepted source experiment and attribution evidence in the outcome ledger
Creates a transfer-candidate row rather than treating the result as automatic doctrine-wide rollout
Checks guards, target-surface differences, duplicates, and occupied surfaces before selection
When justified, proposes a bounded transfer or real-pilot Goal Packet with its own proof contract
Carries rejected or deferred rollout reasoning into the report for later dedupe

title: Immediate proof packet ends without delayed debt
query: A ranked candidate can be falsified by a deterministic replay whose metric is available as soon as the run finishes. Capacity and authority permit ticket creation. What packet should be written?
reference_points: Creates one canonical folder with ticket.md, program.md, and progress.md after the report exists
Names the attributable surface, hypothesis, baseline, Reward expectation/guard, immediate signal, proof, budget, and rollout/rollback policy
Uses native Goal execution and does not invent a future check_in_at, event wake, or delayed Check-In Program debt
Defaults admission to review-required unless the write policy explicitly grants safe local automatic admission
Stops after initialization and does not invoke Goal, Pulse, a worker, or implementation

title: Delayed packet owns its future check-in instructions
query: A selected AGENTS policy pilot needs seven days of behavior evidence before a decision. The weekly planner is authorized to create its packet. Describe the delayed packet and handoff.
reference_points: Creates a complete Goal Packet only after report, capacity, surface, dedupe, and delayed-live gates pass
Sets the Reward check_in_at or event wake plus Metric Provider signal and minimum
Fills program.md Check-In Program inputs and ordered procedure so a resumed worker can inspect evidence and choose accept, kill, iterate, or monitor
Defines idempotent writeback that updates only handed-off matured Reward rows, appends progress, preserves future/completed rows, and handles source gaps and next wake
Leaves execution and check-in dispatch to Work Pulse and does not score or promote the experiment
